column2: Combat Celebrant's ability untaps all of your creatures
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (template error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): the 2017-04-18 ruling's 'untaps all of your creatures' includes Combat Celebrant, but the card says 'untap all other creatures you control', so an exerted Combat Celebrant stays tapped (tests/rulings/ruling_contradicting_oracle.rs). Likely origin (an inference): a loose restatement modeled on Lightning Runner's ruling (2017-02-09) 'You untap all creatures you control, including ones that aren't attacking.', written for the same design without 'other' ('untap all creatures you control, and after this phase, there is an additional combat phase'). Its 'not just the ones that are attacking' agrees with the card and stays cited (tests/rulings/r_p056_extra_phases.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
